verdicts.reason: A is close to unusable. Both dog illustrations are shrunk to tiny icons and crammed into a cluster with the red shapes under the headline. A huge empty red circle sits on the right, the 'Just Humans.' subline is tiny, and most of the canvas is dead space. B keeps both dogs with their red circles and reads left to right. But the dogs are tiny and jammed against the canvas edges, the second dog sits beside its circle instead of in front of it, and the red notch shapes now look like clumsy flag and house blocks hugging the text. 'Just Humans.' is set beside the headline instead of under it, and the grouping is cramped.
